Results.ReviewText: I have had this grill for a month now and it outperforms any gas grill I have ever had. The design is attractive and features such as the gas tank fill meter (based on weight of the tank), the foldable side table, and the removable junk collector below the grill were things I didn't know I wanted in a grill that I'm happy I have. It heats up really quickly and keeps that heat really well. I have had two gas grills in the past with other brands and this one outperforms that by far in this regard. Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I've grilled about 10 meals on this so far - shrimp, filet mignon, flank steak, chicken, snapper... and I'm so impressed!  I've previously had cheaper grills and spent a lot of time visiting this Weber in the store in person and researching online before I committed to buying it. It was so worth the extra $.  Grilling is so much fun on it (char mark heaven!), great heat distribution.  Even better, clean up is so painless I actually do it.  Scraping stuff into the little foil pan for emptying - love it!  I wasn't sure about having the tank visible - but the little Weber cover for it is so cute I'm now a fan, and I love seeing how close I am to empty with the scale they have included.  I really was shocked at the dramatic grilling difference on this, and I've been grilling stuff for 20 years on other grills.

Results.ReviewText:
For nearly 10 years I had a different brand's 4 burner grill and was happy with it, but everything has a lifespan and I decided this spring it was time to replace it. A lot of what goes on my grill is roasted using indirect heat. I'd never have thought that would be possible on 3 burner grill until I checked this one out and saw how far apart the outside burners are. It was finally time to upgrade to a Weber!  I've used it for about month, at least 3x/week and couldn't be happier with the results every time, whether I'm just grilling a steak and some veggies or roasting a chicken.  And because the space on my back porch is a bit tight, I especially like the drop-down side shelf.

Results.ReviewText: I have had a number of grills in my life, lower to middle priced, and none ever performed like this Weber. If your that person that doesn’t want to spend a few more bucks on a grill think again, 10 warranty, that means you won’t buy a new grill for at least 10 years. Results.Title: Great grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: After having this grill and using it for a couple of months I have to revise my original 5 Star to a 3 Star.  The reason for this is the temperature control of the grill.  We have been experiencing 90 degree weather and trying to regulate a low temp. is  difficult.  I replaced a Genesis Silver II with this one and I had no problems with it, even if I wanted to slow cook in the 250 degree range.  The Spirit, if I start out on low eventually works itself up to 350 to 375 degrees.  I have to turn a burner off to get it to run around 350 degree.  I haven't even tried slow cooking on it.  I don't know if it is the design of the lid or what.  I do think Weber needs to make some modifications on them and correct or replace the ones in consumer use.  Certainly a major problem which needs correcting. I'm hoping in cold temperatures it has enough to get the temperature up in the higher range. Just doesn't appear the controls change the flame size much.  I should have kept my Genesis Silver II.
Results.Title: Good small grill but temperature setting a problem

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
